model: C-IO: locally moving finite-alphabet read-only input tape x# plus one designated single-head writable output tape; arbitrary fixed finite work tapes/control are permitted; every real transition priced one
qualification: Mandatory successful EOF authentication and literal x# output; not ordinary SAT decision, no implied native proof emit
state: (source x#, fixed program/control, all tape symbols/heads, historical largest source index read r, output correctness vector, halt/goal, full paid ledger)
zeroCost: No authentic zero-cost machine steps. cl0 identity. Reversible metadata views that do not mutate physical state may be quotient aliases only if all p unchanged.
components: B-1-r (unobserved rightmost physical source cells, r=-1 initially)
B - number of currently correct designated x# output cells + 1[not successfully halted]

signedFullStepLimits.input: delta_interface in {0,1} including input reread, head reversals and waiting
signedFullStepLimits.output: change in correct output cells in {-1,0,1}; at most one designated output cell altered
signedFullStepLimits.work: other work tapes, caches, rereads, recomputation all cost one per physical microstep

rows.notes: new rightmost observed input cell; no output correction or halt
correct one designated output cell; reread or no new source cell
read frontier advances while correct output is corrupted
may incur new work tape changes or head motion
all output already correct and EOF authenticated
simultaneous final output correction and halt
actual final transition of M_sync; strongest row

exactCone.sufficiency: for every one-step legal transition delta_interface<=1 and delta_machine<=2; nonnegative weights

goal.predicate: input # at position B-1 has genuinely been read, each of B designated output cells physically contains exact x#, and machine has successfully halted

lp.attainment: M_sync performs exactly B transitions for any x; writes one output cell per transition; reads input simultaneously

resourceLedger.parallelSpan: B on the single sequential processor
resourceLedger.peakWritableCells: B output tape cells, zero other work tapes for M_sync
resourceLedger.retention: entire explicit copy B cells at halt
resourceLedger.retrievalAndRecomputation: permitted in the larger C-IO legal transition envelope; every transition charged
resourceLedger.costPartition: read, output and halt are overlapping resources of a single native step and cannot be added

controls: source rereads and local head reversals
one last source read, output write, control HALT all in one step
arbitrary other work tapes, compact source computation does not avoid explicitly mandatory output cells
not an implication for one-bit SAT decision, or any imposed proof certificate
scope: Native physical I/O lower bound PROVED/RESTRICTED. The input and output goal is a copied full stream, not SAT. Superpolynomial initial potential and same-SAT-machine transfer OPEN; P versus NP OPEN.
